governing_object: Sun-centered geometric radial extrema represented by a 10-day, seven-node Type-13 Hermite series

authority.source: NASA/JPL Horizons VECTORS and JPL SBDB Query API

limitations: The direct branch validates every 5-day off-grid witness neighboring a radial-velocity sign crossing returned by Horizons over the catalog build interval.
The outer branch is an invariant bound for bound Sun-dominated elliptic motion, not a direct Horizons replay of all 11,097 outer-domain bodies.
This audit governs apsidal sampling; it is not a general all-epoch close-encounter position audit.
